correctness.rationale: For H(5,2), construct all 6212 augmented independent faces directly from 2-/3-subset incidence. Mod-two boundaries limit possible rational Betti groups to degrees 4,5, with dims <=1,5. Exact sign-isotypic rational boundary ranks (degree 3=4, 4=16, 5=9, 9=2) establish a genuine sign class in H4; Euler =-4 forces H5 dimension5. Complement alternating trace on sign-chains is -1; direct fixed-simplex signed Lefschetz on all 14 S5×C2 conjugacy configurations gives character H4=sgn⊗epsilon, H5=Q^[5]⊗epsilon. Independently recreated 6212-face complex, sign-chain dimensions (4,20,26,9,2,2), rational ranks 4/16/9/2, complement trace -1, and sample joint class traces. Rational invariant subspaces yield correct quotient claims, not contractibility.
